### Observed differences

- The alternative step pair A19/A20 disappeared. Before, every trace executed exactly one of the two — A19 in about 45 of 100 traces, A20 in about 55 of 100 — while in the later window A19 appears in 0 of 200 traces, A20 in about 1 of 100, and about 99 of 100 traces contain neither. [OCC002, OCC003, REL008]
- Their ties to the surrounding steps were lost. Before, A19 and A20 each co-occurred with A26, A27 and A28 in roughly 45–55 of 100 traces, ran in either order relative to A27, and virtually always ran before A28; in the later window A26, A27 and A28 appear without either of them in about 99–100 of 100 traces. [REL009, REL010, REL011, REL014, REL015, REL016]
- Routing closed the gap. Before, A26's outgoing transitions went to A27 in about 47 of 100 cases and to A19 or A20 in about half, and A27 went to A28 in about 51 of 100 with most of the rest going to A19/A20; in the later window A26 leads to A27 in about 99 of 100 transitions and A27 leads to A28 in about 99 of 100. [DIR004, DIR005]
- Distances shortened accordingly: A26 is followed immediately by A27 in about 98 of 100 cases (before about 47), A27 is followed immediately by A28 in essentially all cases (before about 52), and A28 now follows A26 two steps later in about 98 of 100 cases (before three steps in about 96). [LAG003, LAG004, LAG005]
- A08 became more frequent and moved late in the trace: participation rose from about 7 to about 28 of 100 traces, its median position moved from about 0.44 to about 0.89 of the trace, it now typically runs after A26/A27/A28, and its outgoing transitions — previously spread over many activities — now go to A44 in about 88 of 100 cases; A43 now leads to A08 in about 35 of 100 transitions (before about 93 went to A44). [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR006, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, LAG006]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

Screening flagged 38 items where roughly 0.6 would be expected if nothing had changed, and every item's difference exceeds about 995 of 1000 random re-splits, so chance cannot explain the volume as a whole. Within it, the evidence supports the possibility that the mutually exclusive alternative pair A19 and A20 — which before ran in every trace between A26 and the A27→A28 ending, in either order relative to A27 and virtually always before A28 — is no longer executed in the later window, so cases proceed directly A26 → A27 → A28. Supporting signs: A19 fell from 91 to 0 of 200 traces and A20 from 109 to 2; all co-occurrence of A19/A20 with A26, A27 and A28 disappeared; A26 and A27 now route almost exclusively to A27 and A28; and the A26→A28 distance shortened from three steps to two, exactly what dropping one intermediate step predicts. [OCC002, OCC003, REL008, REL009, REL010, REL011, REL014, REL015, REL016, DIR004, DIR005, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005]

Limitations: zero participation strictly means only that A19 and A20 were not observed in the later window, and the evidence cannot show why they disappeared; it also cannot rule out that the two windows sampled different mixes of process variants rather than one modified process. The after-side profiles for A20 and its lags rest on only one or two traces. [OCC002, OCC003, DIR003, LAG001, LAG002]

Other differences: A08 participation rose from about 7 to about 28 of 100 traces and it now sits late in the trace, typically after A26/A27/A28, with its outgoing transitions concentrated on A44 (about 88 of 100) and A43 now leading to A08 in about a third of its transitions; the before-side lag evidence for A43→A08 rests on only four observations. [OCC001, POS001, DIR001, DIR006, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, LAG006]
